Name: Luxury Meals
Author: xXStrayXx
Description:
This is a mod added several luxury meals using expensive or considered to be luxurious materials like truffle oil, ancient fruit and caviar.
Well, the description of truffle oil says it's "A gourmet cooking ingredient.", but it's not actually used in any cooking recipe. I got the conception of this mod from this fact.
The recipe of the Flesh Cloner required to make steaks will be send by Demetrius once you've reached 5 hearts with him.
The way to receive the cooking recipes are listed below.
Truffle Oil Salad, Truffle Oil Spaghetti and Truffle Pizza: Reach 4/5/6 hearts with Gus.
Egg Caviar, Fried Truffle, Deluxe Dinner and Deluxe Fruit Salad: Reach 3/5/7/9 hearts with Krobus.
Fried Dinosaur Egg, Ancient Lunch, Ancient Fruit Salad: Reach 3/5/7 hearts with Dwarf.
Ancient Fruit Ice Cream and Starfruit Ice Cream: reach 5/6 hearts with Sandy.
Roe Sushi, Roasted Pufferfish, Braised Sea Cucumber and Super Lucky Lunch: reach 3/5/7/9 hearts with Willy AND reach level 6 in fishing.
Fried Steak, Truffle Oil Steak and Steak Dinner: reach 3/5/7 hearts with Alex.
Truffle Soup and Rice with Steak And Truffle: reach 4/6 hearts with Haley.

这个mod加了几个用很贵或者很“豪华”的材料做的豪华食物（比如用松露油，远古果，杨桃，鱼籽酱之类做的东西）
松露油的描述写着“佳肴必备的原料”，但是这玩意相关的烹饪配方完全没有，所以我做了个这玩意。
用来做牛排的血肉克隆仪在老德五心以后会寄过来
获取烹饪食谱的方法如下所示。
松露油沙拉，松露油意大利面和松露比萨：格斯4/5/6颗心。
鸡蛋鱼子酱、炒松露、豪华晚餐和豪华水果沙拉：小黑3/5/7/9颗心。
恐龙煎蛋、远古午餐、远古水果沙拉：矮人3/5/7颗心。
远古果冰淇淋和杨桃冰淇淋：桑迪5/6颗心。
鱼子寿司，烧河豚，烧海参，超级幸运午餐：威利3/5/7/9颗星，钓鱼6级。
炸牛排，松露油牛排和牛排晚餐：亚历克斯3/5/7颗心。
松露汤和牛排松露拌饭：海莉4/6颗心。
